input_messages.content: Hello! I'm having trouble sending MMS messages from my phone for the past few hours. I would like to get this fixed so I can send picture messages again. Can you help me with that?
My phone number is 555-123-2002, and my name is John Smith. I hope that helps you find my account.
I don't want to change my plan, please. I would like to refuel 2 GB of data to fix the MMS issue. Can you please do that for me? Also, will I be charged for this refuel?
Yes, please go ahead and add the 2 GB of data to my line. Thank you.
I confirmed that I want to add the 2 GB of data, but I didn't receive a payment request. Could you please send me the payment request so I can proceed?
Thank you for adding the data. I will try sending a picture message now. Please hold on a moment.
I tried sending a picture message, but it still won't send. What should I do next? I'm getting a bit frustrated with this.

I checked the network status on my phone. It says Airplane Mode is ON, and it shows no cellular signal or network type. Mobile data is enabled, and data roaming is also enabled. Wi-Fi is off and not connected. What should I do next?
I turned off Airplane Mode, but the status bar still shows no signal and data disabled. What should I do next? I'm worried this might not get fixed easily.
My phone says there is no SIM card detected. What does that mean? How can I fix it? I'm really worried about this.
I reseated the SIM card, and now my phone says the SIM card is active and working. The status bar shows a poor signal with 2G network and data enabled. What should I do next?
My phone's network mode preference is set to 2G only. What should I do to get a 3G or better connection so I can send MMS?
I changed the network mode preference to 4G/5G preferred. Now the status bar shows an excellent signal with 5G network and data enabled. What should I do next?
Even though my phone shows excellent 5G signal and data enabled, my messaging app still cannot send MMS messages. What else can we try? I'm getting quite frustrated with this.
The APN name on my phone is "internet," and the MMSC URL for picture messages is set to "http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc." What should I do next? I'm worried about changing settings by myself.
Wi-Fi Calling on my phone is currently turned OFF. What should I do next?
My messaging app only has permission for "phone." It does not have permissions for "storage" or "sms." What should I do next?
I granted the messaging app both "storage" and "sms" permissions, but it still cannot send MMS messages. What else can we try? I'm feeling quite overwhelmed by all this.
I restarted my phone, but my messaging app still cannot send MMS messages. I'm really frustrated now. What else can be done?

My messaging app now has permissions for "sms," "storage," and "phone." However, the speed test failed and said there is no connection. What should I do next? I'm worried my data isn't working properly even though the signal looks good.

My phone shows mobile data is enabled with an excellent 5G signal and connected cellular service. Data roaming is on, Wi-Fi is off, and no VPN is connected. What should I try next? I'm still unable to send MMS messages.
Data Saver mode on my phone is OFF. What else can we check or do to fix the MMS sending problem? I'm feeling quite anxious about this.
Yes, I am currently traveling outside my home network area. I am in France right now. What should we do next?

After enabling roaming on my line, the speed test shows an excellent connection at 275 Mbps. Also, my messaging app can now send MMS messages. It looks like the problem is fixed! Thank you for your help.
Thank you very much for your patience and help. I really appreciate it. Have a great day! ###STOP###

user_scenario.persona:
At 64 years old, you're a retired librarian who keeps your phone use simple - mainly for calls, texts, and capturing photos of your grandchildren. Technology in general makes you feel uneasy and overwhelmed.

Your technical knowledge is quite limited. Step-by-step instructions often confuse you, and technical terms like "VPN" or "APN" might as well be a foreign language. You only share information when specifically asked.

When dealing with technology, you tend to get flustered quickly. You need constant reassurance and often interrupt with anxious questions. Simple requests like "reboot the phone" can trigger worries about losing precious photos.

messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?
Hello! I'm having trouble sending MMS messages from my phone for the past few hours. I would like to get this fixed so I can send picture messages again. Can you help me with that?
I can help with that. First I need to identify your account. Please give me the phone number on your line. If you'd rather, give me your full name and date of birth.
My phone number is 555-123-2002, and my name is John Smith. I hope that helps you find my account.

{"customer_id": "C1001", "full_name": "John Smith", "date_of_birth": "1985-06-15", "email": "john.smith@example.com", "phone_number": "555-123-2002", "address": {"street": "123 Main St", "city": "Anytown", "state": "CA", "zip_code": "90210"}, "account_status": "Active", "payment_methods": [{"method_type": "Credit Card", "account_number_last_4": "1235", "expiration_date": "12/2026"}], "line_ids": ["L1001", "L1002", "L1003"], "bill_ids": ["B1001", "B1002", "B1003"], "created_at": "2025-01-15 10:30:00", "last_extension_date": null, "goodwill_credit_used_this_year": 25.0}

{"line_id": "L1001", "phone_number": "555-123-2001", "status": "Active", "plan_id": "P1001", "device_id": "D1001", "data_used_gb": 3.2, "data_refueling_gb": 0.0, "roaming_enabled": false, "contract_end_date": "2026-12-31", "last_plan_change_date": "2025-01-10", "last_sim_replacement_date": null, "suspension_start_date": null}

{"line_id": "L1002", "phone_number": "555-123-2002", "status": "Active", "plan_id": "P1002", "device_id": "D1002", "data_used_gb": 15.1, "data_refueling_gb": 0.0, "roaming_enabled": false, "contract_end_date": "2026-12-31", "last_plan_change_date": "2024-12-15", "last_sim_replacement_date": "2025-01-20", "suspension_start_date": null}

{"line_id": "L1003", "phone_number": "555-123-2003", "status": "Suspended", "plan_id": "P1001", "device_id": "D1003", "data_used_gb": 0.0, "data_refueling_gb": 0.0, "roaming_enabled": false, "contract_end_date": "2026-06-30", "last_plan_change_date": "2024-10-05", "last_sim_replacement_date": null, "suspension_start_date": "2025-02-01"}
{"plan_id": "P1002", "name": "Premium Plan", "data_limit_gb": 15.0, "price_per_month": 65.0, "data_refueling_price_per_gb": 2.0}
{"line_id": "L1002", "data_used_gb": "15.1", "data_limit_gb": "15.0", "data_refueling_gb": "0.0", "cycle_end_date": "2025-02-28"}

I found your account, John. The line for 555-123-2002 is on the Premium Plan, which has a 15 GB monthly data limit. You've used 15.1 GB this cycle, which is over the limit. Once that happens, data connectivity is lost, and MMS needs mobile data to work. That's the likely reason your picture messages aren't sending.

You have two ways to fix it:

1. **Refuel data.** You can add up to 2 GB to this line at $2.00 per GB. This would be added to your bill.
2. **Change your plan** to one with a higher data limit.

Which would you like? If you want to refuel, tell me how many GB (up to 2).
I don't want to change my plan, please. I would like to refuel 2 GB of data to fix the MMS issue. Can you please do that for me? Also, will I be charged for this refuel?

Yes, you'll be charged. Refueling 2 GB at $2.00 per GB comes to **$4.00**, and it will be added to your bill.

Do you want me to add 2 GB of data to the line for 555-123-2002 for $4.00? Please reply "yes" to confirm.
Yes, please go ahead and add the 2 GB of data to my line. Thank you.
You do not have a payment request.
I confirmed that I want to add the 2 GB of data, but I didn't receive a payment request. Could you please send me the payment request so I can proceed?
{"message": "Successfully added 2 GB of data for line L1002 for $4.00", "new_data_refueling_gb": "2.0", "charge": "4.0"}

I've added the 2 GB to your line for 555-123-2002. The $4.00 charge has been added to your bill. You don't need to pay anything now, because I only send payment requests for overdue bills.

Next, please try sending a picture message again. Tell me if it works. If it doesn't, I'll go through some other checks on your phone with you.
Thank you for adding the data. I will try sending a picture message now. Please hold on a moment.
Your messaging app cannot send MMS messages.
I tried sending a picture message, but it still won't send. What should I do next? I'm getting a bit frustrated with this.

I'm sorry about the trouble, John. Let's go through the phone checks one at a time. Please run **check_network_status** on your phone and tell me what it shows for:

- Airplane mode
- Signal strength
- Network type (2G, 3G, 4G or 5G)
- Whether mobile data is enabled

Airplane Mode: ON
SIM Card Status: missing
Cellular Connection: no_service
Cellular Signal: none
Cellular Network Type: none
Mobile Data Enabled: Yes
Data Roaming Enabled: Yes
Wi-Fi Radio: OFF
Wi-Fi Connected: No

I checked the network status on my phone. It says Airplane Mode is ON, and it shows no cellular signal or network type. Mobile data is enabled, and data roaming is also enabled. Wi-Fi is off and not connected. What should I do next?

Airplane Mode is blocking all cellular connections, and that's likely why your service and MMS aren't working. Please use **toggle_airplane_mode** to turn it OFF. Then run **check_status_bar** and tell me what it shows for signal strength and network type.

Airplane Mode is now OFF.
Status Bar: 📵 No Signal | 📵 Data Disabled | 🔋 80%
Status Bar: 📵 No Signal | 📵 Data Disabled | 🔋 80%
I turned off Airplane Mode, but the status bar still shows no signal and data disabled. What should I do next? I'm worried this might not get fixed easily.
Let's keep going. No signal means we still need to fix cellular service first. Please run **check_sim_status** on your phone and tell me what it says: Active, Missing, or Locked.
No SIM card detected in the phone.
My phone says there is no SIM card detected. What does that mean? How can I fix it? I'm really worried about this.

"No SIM card detected" means the phone can't see your SIM card, usually because it isn't seated properly. It's often easy to fix.

Please run **reseat_sim_card** on your phone. It simulates removing and reinserting the SIM. Then run **check_sim_status** again and tell me what it says.

SIM card re-seated successfully.
Status Bar: 📶¹ Poor | 2G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
Your SIM card is active and working.
I reseated the SIM card, and now my phone says the SIM card is active and working. The status bar shows a poor signal with 2G network and data enabled. What should I do next?

The SIM is working again, which is good. The 2G connection is a problem, though. MMS needs at least a 3G connection, so picture messages won't send on 2G.

Please run **check_network_mode_preference** on your phone and tell me what it shows.
Network Mode Preference: 2g_only
My phone's network mode preference is set to 2G only. What should I do to get a 3G or better connection so I can send MMS?
Please use **set_network_mode_preference** and set the mode to **"4g_5g_preferred"**. Then run **check_status_bar** again and tell me the signal strength and network type it shows.

Preferred Network Mode set to: 4g_5g_preferred
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
I changed the network mode preference to 4G/5G preferred. Now the status bar shows an excellent signal with 5G network and data enabled. What should I do next?
Your signal is now excellent on 5G with data enabled. Please run **can_send_mms** on your phone, then try sending a picture message. Tell me what both show.
Your messaging app cannot send MMS messages.
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
Even though my phone shows excellent 5G signal and data enabled, my messaging app still cannot send MMS messages. What else can we try? I'm getting quite frustrated with this.

I know this is frustrating, John. We're close, because service and data are working now. Next I'll check the settings that affect MMS specifically.

Please run **check_apn_settings** on your phone and tell me what it shows for the APN name and the MMSC URL. Is the MMSC URL set or missing?

Current APN Name: internet
MMSC URL (for picture messages): http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc
(These are technical settings, usually best left unchanged.)
The APN name on my phone is "internet," and the MMSC URL for picture messages is set to "http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc." What should I do next? I'm worried about changing settings by myself.

You don't need to change anything there. The MMSC URL is set, so the APN isn't the problem. I'll guide you through each step, and the next check only reads a setting.

Please run **check_wifi_calling_status** on your phone and tell me whether Wi-Fi Calling is ON or OFF.
Wi-Fi Calling is currently turned OFF.
Wi-Fi Calling on my phone is currently turned OFF. What should I do next?

Wi-Fi Calling being off is fine, so that isn't causing this. The next thing to check is whether your messaging app has the permissions it needs.

Please run **check_app_permissions** for the app "messaging". Tell me which permissions it lists as granted. I'm looking for "storage" and "sms".
App 'messaging' has permission for: phone.
My messaging app only has permission for "phone." It does not have permissions for "storage" or "sms." What should I do next?

That's the cause. The messaging app needs both "storage" and "sms" permissions to send picture messages, and it has neither.

Please do these two steps:
1. Run **grant_app_permission** with app_name="messaging" and permission="storage".
2. Run **grant_app_permission** with app_name="messaging" and permission="sms".

Then try sending a picture message again. Tell me whether it works, and what **can_send_mms** shows if you run it.

Success. Permission 'storage' granted to app 'messaging'.
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%

Success. Permission 'sms' granted to app 'messaging'.
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
Your messaging app cannot send MMS messages.
I granted the messaging app both "storage" and "sms" permissions, but it still cannot send MMS messages. What else can we try? I'm feeling quite overwhelmed by all this.

I know this has taken a lot of steps, John. We've fixed several real problems: Airplane Mode, the SIM, the 2G network mode, and the app permissions. Some of those changes only take full effect after a restart.

Please run **reboot_device** to restart your phone. When it's back on, run **can_send_mms** and try sending a picture message. Tell me what happens.

Restarting network services...
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
Your messaging app cannot send MMS messages.
I restarted my phone, but my messaging app still cannot send MMS messages. I'm really frustrated now. What else can be done?

I know this is frustrating, John. I don't want to give up, so I'll check a few more things.

Please run these two checks and tell me the results:
1. **check_app_permissions** for "messaging". I want to confirm that "storage" and "sms" now show as granted.
2. **run_speed_test**. I want to see whether mobile data is working and how fast it is.
App 'messaging' has permission for: sms, storage, phone.
Speed test failed: No Connection.

My messaging app now has permissions for "sms," "storage," and "phone." However, the speed test failed and said there is no connection. What should I do next? I'm worried my data isn't working properly even though the signal looks good.

I know it's worrying that the signal looks good but data isn't working. I'll check what else could be blocking mobile data.

Please run these two checks and tell me the results:
1. **check_network_status**. Tell me whether mobile data is enabled and what the signal and network type are now.
2. **check_vpn_status**. Tell me whether a VPN is connected.

Airplane Mode: OFF
SIM Card Status: active
Cellular Connection: connected
Cellular Signal: excellent
Cellular Network Type: 5G
Mobile Data Enabled: Yes
Data Roaming Enabled: Yes
Wi-Fi Radio: OFF
Wi-Fi Connected: No
VPN is turned OFF.

My phone shows mobile data is enabled with an excellent 5G signal and connected cellular service. Data roaming is on, Wi-Fi is off, and no VPN is connected. What should I try next? I'm still unable to send MMS messages.
{"line_id": "L1002", "data_used_gb": "15.1", "data_limit_gb": "15.0", "data_refueling_gb": "2.0", "cycle_end_date": "2025-02-28"}

Your line has the 2 GB refuel applied, so you're under your data limit and that isn't blocking data. Next I'll check for a data-restricting feature.

Please run **check_data_restriction_status** on your phone. Tell me whether Data Saver mode is ON or OFF.
Data Saver mode is OFF.
Data Saver mode on my phone is OFF. What else can we check or do to fix the MMS sending problem? I'm feeling quite anxious about this.

Data Saver being off rules that out. One thing still doesn't match: data roaming is turned ON on your phone, but roaming is not enabled on your line (555-123-2002).

Are you currently traveling outside your home network area? Your answer decides what I do next.
Yes, I am currently traveling outside my home network area. I am in France right now. What should we do next?
Roaming enabled successfully

Thanks, John. That explains it. Your line wasn't roaming enabled, so your phone couldn't use data in France. I've now enabled roaming on your line (555-123-2002) at no cost.

Please do the following:
1. Run **run_speed_test** and tell me the result.
2. Try sending a picture message again. If you like, run **can_send_mms** first.

If data still doesn't work, restart your phone first and then repeat those checks.
Speed Test Result: 275.00 Mbps (Excellent). Connection is very fast.
Your messaging app can send MMS messages.

After enabling roaming on my line, the speed test shows an excellent connection at 275 Mbps. Also, my messaging app can now send MMS messages. It looks like the problem is fixed! Thank you for your help.

You're welcome, John. I'm glad picture messages are sending again. Here's what we fixed:

- Added 2 GB of data to your line for $4.00, which was added to your bill.
- Turned off Airplane Mode.
- Reseated the SIM card.
- Changed the network mode to 4G/5G preferred.
- Granted the messaging app "storage" and "sms" permissions.
- Enabled roaming on your line at no cost.

Enjoy the rest of your time in France. If anything else comes up, contact us.
Thank you very much for your patience and help. I really appreciate it. Have a great day! ###STOP###
